purpose: Teach: ドナー/太陽系/火薬/油田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ドナー登録啓発のCSR活動を進めろ
lines.en: Push ahead with our CSR campaign promoting donor registration.
lines.style: Crisp directive attack, clipped consonants, no wasted words, quiet unarguable authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。太陽系研究機関への寄付を継続します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll continue the donations to solar system research institutes.
lines.style: Prompt professional affirmation, steady mid-pace, dutiful clarity without hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、産業用火薬の安全管理を徹底しろ
lines.en: Make our safety management of industrial gunpowder absolutely airtight.
lines.style: Firm and deliberate, weight landing hard on 'airtight', pace that brooks no argument.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外油田事業への投資を慎重に判断します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll weigh the investment in overseas oil field ventures carefully.
lines.style: Immediate yes, then careful measured delivery signaling genuine caution on the investment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ドナー登録の社員啓発活動も支援しろ
lines.en: And back the employee awareness drive for donor registration as well.
lines.style: Slightly softer directive, still clipped, a faint approving note beneath the command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。火薬類取扱社員の安全研修を徹底します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll run thorough safety training for the staff handling explosives.
lines.style: Brisk closing confirmation, precise and steady, ending clean like a checklist completed.
